$comment: The one place the character lives. Both halves read it: the brain (backend/persona.py) for the voice per language, the name in the prompt and greetings; the page (frontend/src/persona.ts) for the avatar character, the name in the UI and the language toggle. To change the character, edit character, name and voices here. To add a language, add its voice under voices and its code to languages (Fernhollow is English only today).
name: Emily
